page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused instance type designed for data-intensive workload environments. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of RAM, which equates to 4.0 GB per virtual core.
A key specification of the ecs.d1.6xlarge server is its bundled 70,866 GB of direct-attached local HDD storage. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and delivers an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

The hardware configuration delivers high disk storage density, offering qualitative cost efficiency for operations requiring vast data capacity without relying on external block storage. A prominent tradeoff is the use of HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, trading random I/O performance for high local volume capacity.
This instance is suited for big data processing frameworks, distributed file systems, data warehousing, log aggregation, and large-scale analytical batch processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a high-density storage instance designed for data-intensive processing workloads. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs alongside 96.0 GB of memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per core ratio. The server features 70,866 GB of local HDD storage directly attached to the system, along with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth running under a KVM hypervisor. The primary tradeoff of this instance configuration is its reliance on high-capacity local HDDs, prioritizing raw storage capacity over high-speed SSD throughput or IOPS. The ecs.d1.6xlarge is cost-effective for holding massive data volumes locally without network-attached storage overhead. It is best suited for big data analytics, distributed file systems, data archiving, and batch log processing.
